items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: he played a record with a couple of Juan's tunes that I had never heard, and I asked him if he would make a tape of it, and he said yes

ctx.x: Oh, the new one in Westwood? No, I haven't been there; I was to his old place.

Yeah, and the night that Duke died, or the night after Duke died, Bob Yutak had quite a few people over, and everybody that was in Los Angeles who used to be in Duke's band, he had up to his house, and played Duke's records and so forth and so on, and he played a record with a couple of Juan's tunes that I had never heard, and I asked him if he would make a tape of it, and he said yes, and he did make a tape and sent it to us.
